findings.reason: English resume is already «возобновить» in this locale (wire.slash.resume, wire.slash.archive); «продолж-» is the locale's verb for English continue (tui.notices.budget_exhausted_continue, relay.asks.gate.keep_asking). Aligning removes the drift and keeps the two verbs distinct.
evidence: ru/wire.slash.resume: «Выбрать прошлую беседу или возобновить её (id)» for en 'Pick a past conversation to resume, or resume one (id)'
ru/wire.slash.archive: «…по id всё ещё можно возобновить» for en '…still resumable by id'
hint updated in the same pass; session.resume appears verbatim in session.ended_hint (checked programmatically)
findings.width_note: session.resuming «Возобновляем…» = 13 cells vs maxCells 12; U+2026 is required product typography and no clipping was measured (source-side). Flagged for the rendered-fit pass rather than degraded to a shortened/inflected form.

findings.reason: «для» governs the genitive while {name} is inserted verbatim in the nominative, so «Действия для Сборка релиза» is ungrammatical. The colon construction is case-free and already this surface's pattern for interpolated accessibility labels.
evidence: sibling accessible names use the same pattern: composer.folder_label «Рабочая папка: {name}», model_label «Модель: {label}», spend_label «Расходы и контекст: {label}»
